capabilities: Edit .typ documents with completion, hover docs, go-to-definition, and formatting
Show compiler diagnostics underlined in the editor as you type
Preview the rendered document in a workspace leaf with two-way source navigation
Create Typst projects and edit BibLaTeX, Hayagriva, YAML, and TOML files with highlighting
disambiguation: Not the Tinymist language server itself; it is an Obsidian plugin that launches and drives a separately installed Tinymist executable.
extras: Desktop only; Obsidian mobile cannot launch the executable. Only one plugin can own the .typ extension. The README includes a detailed privacy/security section explaining why automated review flags network calls (a loopback preview server) and child_process usage. No accounts, telemetry, or network requests except Typst package imports.
motivation: The author uses Obsidian for thinking, research, and writing, but documents needing serious typesetting meant leaving the vault; the plugin closes that gap.
problem: Obsidian has no Typst support, so documents needing serious typesetting forced users to leave the vault for another app.

relations.evidence: Built on Tinymist by Myriad-Dreamin, and Typst.
Built on Tinymist by Myriad-Dreamin, and Typst.
Typst syntax highlighting comes from codemirror-lang-typst.

requires.name: Tinymist 0.13.0+ executable (installed via brew, cargo, scoop, winget, or GitHub releases)
Obsidian desktop 1.13.0+ on a filesystem vault

summary: Typst editor and preview plugin that edits .typ documents with Tinymist language intelligence, live-previews the rendered output, and exports PDFs into the vault.
